# Anthony Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P5](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0005)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

He has a dark, sullen little face with black eyes.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)_

## Personality

He is sullen, mischievous, and insolent, harboring a contemptuous view of female teachers. Despite his rebellious behavior, he is an independent boy who holds his own opinions.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c5 P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c7 P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 c12 P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001), [v2 c12 P30](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0030)_

## Traits

- Sullen  <sub>[v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010)</sub>
- Mischievous  <sub>[v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005)</sub>

## Abilities

- Fighting  <sub>[v2 c26 P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034)</sub>

## History

Anthony Pye is taken in by his uncle's wife, Mrs. George Pye, and attends the Avonlea school under Anne Shirley. Initially, he harbors a strong contempt for Anne, declaring that girl teachers are no good and disrupting the classroom with mischievous acts such as pouring slate bottle water down Aurelia Clay's neck. He continues his defiance by placing a live mouse in Anne's desk drawer, prompting her to whip him with a hardwood pointer. Unexpectedly, this punishment earns his respect, leading him to offer to carry her books and openly admit that she is capable after all. When Anne resigns from her teaching position, Anthony vents his grief by engaging in two pitched battles with other students.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c5 P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026), [v2 c7 P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 c12 P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023), [v2 c12 P30](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0030), [v2 c12 P31](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0031), [v2 c12 P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 c12 P49](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0049), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052), [v2 c26 P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034)_
